svg.text: SHUFFLER 2 - converter between PV2+ (T) and GND (B) with the midpoint on PV3+ (M): the hand-drawn v3 power stage (mirror image of converter 1)
Leg A = M5 / M6 (driver X8, PWM_AH / PWM_AL), leg B = M7 / M8 (driver X9, PWM_BH / PWM_BL); X5 = ERUC23 inverse-coupled inductor.
Board capacitors C2 / C4 (130 uF) and C6 (225 nF); V5 (A) and V6 (B) = 0 V sources in the windings, positive into the midpoint.
Ports: T / M / B = the converter rails (cable and copper inductances are on the top sheet); PWM_* = 3.3 V logic from the Controller block;
HS_A / HS_B = TMCS1126 hall-sensor outputs to the Controller (1.65 V + 100 mV/A on A, 1.65 V - 25 mV/A on B: reversed as mounted on the board).
Measure the winding currents from the top sheet as I(V5•XS2) and I(V6•XS2); their difference is the circulating current, their sum the shuffled current.
TMCS1126 HALL SENSORS - on the board at the inductor; 1k + 318.3p = the 500 kHz output pole
